_meta.title: Three-Axis Diagnostic Framework
_meta.status: METACOD-RF — Research Framework, not clinical guidance
_meta.subtitle: First complete integration of three diagnostic axes (Constitution × Membrane × Phase)
_meta.author: Mark Litvak (formalization with AI-assistance)
_meta.supersedes_partially: Constitutional Model v0.1, v0.2 (those remain valid)
architecture_principle: Три независимые диагностические оси: Constitution (slow), Membrane (medium), Phase (fast).
Лечение должно адресовать каждую ось: конституциональное направление (long-term), мембранную коррекцию (medium-term), phase-appropriate timing (short-term).
Препарат, «правильный» по конституции но «неправильный» по мембранному направлению — неэффективен или вреден.
_meta.independence_principle: Три оси независимы (Mark canonical 31-May-2026). 8 × 8 × 5 = 320 комбинаций теоретически; clinically значимы ~30-50 типичных pattern-комбинаций.

critical_constants.energies_note: 5 energies (post 01-Jun-2026 canon): Wind, Heat, Damp, Dry, Cold
critical_constants.two_axis_independence: pH = ENERGY axis, NOT membrane axis (canonical 31-May-2026)

next_steps: Retrospective case documentation using three-axis assessment
Update predictive matrices to include membrane axis
Full development of M-A2/A3/D2/D3 ten-section deployment
Integration with drug database (each drug needs 3-axis profile)

constitutional.principle: Конституция = композиция трёх энергий из 5-element framework; ведущая энергия = последняя в последовательности, определяет type name. Slow-changing baseline.

yin_yang_dominance.yin_dominant: 3 strong Yin energies (incl. leading) + 2 weak Yin; compensatorily 2 strong Yang + 3 weak Yang
yin_yang_dominance.yang_dominant: 3 strong Yang energies (incl. leading) + 2 weak Yang; compensatorily 2 strong Yin + 3 weak Yin
yin_yang_dominance.note: Это две разные архитектуры, не варианты одной.

constitutional.baseline_thermal_asymmetry: Yang-energies всегда несколько теплее baseline чем Yin. Сильное нарушение baseline асимметрии = manifest pathology marker.

quantity.definition: Total flow энергии = Yin-component + Yang-component (метафора реки).
quantity_quality_combinations: Weak quantity + clean quality (deficient но functional)

constitutional.quality: Physiological correctness энергии через biomarkers с optimal range (не unipolar). Слишком высокая quality = pathology (Hb 18 = polycythemia). Полная система — constitutional_model_v0_2.json.
temporal_layers: Biorhythmic layer (organ-specific cycles) — acknowledged, NOT formalized in v1.0
constitutional.open_problem: Constitutional assessment через clinical gestalt опытного клинициста (Mark). Стандартизированного алгоритма нет. НЕ решения: Hamer phase as proxy, single biomarker panel, multi-hundred-question survey.
constitutional.triads_detail_ref: 8 triads detailed in predictive_matrix_01_semaglutide.json (triads[]) and below (compact).

triads.name: Yang-Earth
triads.phenotype: Abdominal obesity, T2DM, NAFLD, damp tongue

triads.name: Yin-Earth
triads.phenotype: Slow obesity, hypothyroid tendency, fluid retention

triads.name: Yin-Water frail elderly
triads.phenotype: Cold + Yang deficit, sarcopenic, low reserve

membrane.principle: Функциональное состояние тканей на шкале anabolic-catabolic. Revici 7 levels → METACOD-RF (Mark) 8 levels including stagnant M-S. Medium-changing (weeks-months). Независим от constitution.
membrane.semantic_M_S: M-S — пограничный патологический режим, НЕ «balanced». Игнорирование M-S — главная причина клинической неудачи (Mark canonical).

M-0.name: Healthy Equilibrium
M-0.definition: Нормальный turnover, alkaline-acid ratio 4:1, blood pH 7.4, balanced K-shift.
clinical_signature: Pain: no specific diurnal pattern / absent

M-A1.name: Early Anabolic Membrane
M-A1.definition: Lipid sterol excess starting; мембраны становятся rigid; tissue alkalosis beginning.
biomarkers: Skin pH more acidic (external zone — opposite, Mark canonical)

M-A2.name: Progressive Anabolic Membrane
clinical_signature: Constitution match: T1, T2 often in M-A2
M-A2.flagship_case_note: Mariana: chronic bronchiectasis + NTM — M-A2 системно + S-flag in bronchial walls.

M-A3.name: Deep Anabolic Membrane
M-A3.definition: Severe anabolic, nephrotic pattern, mass anabolic accumulation.

M-D1.name: Early Catabolic Membrane
M-D1.definition: Mirror of M-A1 — fatty acid excess + peroxidation start; мембраны становятся leaky.

M-D2.name: Progressive Catabolic Membrane
M-D2.definition: Active ferroptosis, weakened membranes, oxidative damage progression.
disease_patterns: Long-term GLP-1 therapy in vulnerable patients

M-D3.name: Deep Catabolic Membrane
M-D3.definition: Massive lipid peroxidation, multi-organ ferroptosis, autoimmune patterns, severe oxidative stress, subnuclear damage.
biomarkers: Ferritin very high or paradoxically low (depletion phase)

M-S.name: Stagnant Pathological Equilibrium
M-S.definition: НЕ «balanced» — патологический residual, где anabolic и catabolic forces заблокировали друг друга в frozen pathology (Mark canonical).
biomarkers: KEY PATTERN: Sterol + MDA или 4-HNE одновременно повышены (paired markers)
Supporting: LDH, fibrinogen, hsCRP, GSH, Selenium whole blood
Cole-Cole α (multifrequency BIA) — PRIMARY M-S indicator
M-S.biomarkers_note: M-S markers new by Mark 18 May 2026.
clinical_signature: Mixed M-A and M-D signs simultaneously
M-S.flagship_case_note: Mariana: M-A2 системно + S-flag (M-S модификатор) localised in bronchial walls — M-S can be localised in one compartment when systemic state is M-A.

M_A1_vs_M_D1_differential.therapeutic_direction: OPPOSITE — M-A1 → catabolic agents (Se, S, Mg, omega-3); M-D1 → anabolic agents (cholesterol, lipid alcohols, Zn, Fe, caffeine)

ph_4point_urine_system.note: Урина — внутренняя зона (revised в v0.5 from v0.4 error). Mark canonical.
measurements: Утром (fasting, first morning) — baseline tissue state
interpretation: All four >6.4 = systemic alkalosis = M-A pattern
All four <6.2 = systemic acidosis = M-D pattern
Variable pattern = transition state or unstable membrane
energy_axis_connection: Alkaline urine = Cold + Dry energy excess
This is ENERGY axis, NOT membrane axis (Mark canonical 31-May-2026)
ph_4point_urine_system.critical: pH connection to membrane is EMPIRICAL CORRELATION, not definitional. Drug-induced dissociation possible.

bia_parameters.cole_cole_alpha: NEW primary M-S indicator (Mark 18 May 2026); reflects ECM stiffness; elevated α suggests fibrotic remodeling = M-S signal

phase.principle: Temporal organization активного процесса. Fast-changing. Независим от constitution и membrane; несколько одновременных процессов в разных фазах возможны.
phase.inspired_by: Hamer's phase observations, STRIPPED of specific psychogenic claims.
phase.trigger_note: Намеренное отделение от specific Hamer-claims, что каждая болезнь начинается с specific эмоционального конфликта.

signature: Brief sympathetic surge in parasympathetic context
Symptomatic crisis (fever spike, severe pain, dramatic event)

phase_regression_open_problem: True phase regression (backward в same cycle)
New cycle starting (CA fresh после Normotonia)
DPM mismatch (phase doesn't match expected progression)
phase.phase_skipping: Strong conflict + low reserve → direct jump к PCL-A/Epicrisis/PCL-B. Explains sudden fibrosis in elderly, rapid progression in frail, need for preventive multi-Yang support.
phase.multi_system_parallelism: Один пациент = несколько одновременных processes в разных systems. Priority hierarchy: acute CA > active inflammatory PCL > chronic PCL-B > maintenance.

constitution_x_membrane.tendency: Slow drift, sometimes M-D1 in late life

constitution_x_membrane.baseline: Variable, often M-A2 with inflammatory overlay
constitution_x_membrane.tendency: Drift to M-D2 in active inflammation periods
Risk M-D2 with stress; gastroparesis = local M-D pattern
Rapid drift M-D2/D3 with any stressor
Often M-S due to competing forces

ph_energy_vs_membrane_independence.ph_is_energy_axis: acid urine/tissue/blood = Heat (Park Огонь); alkaline = Cold + Dry
ph_energy_vs_membrane_independence.membrane_is_separate: determined by SG, K, pain timing, WBC
examples: Mark: M-D + Heat (acid pH) — catabolic с Heat energy excess
Anna: M-D + Cold + Dry (alkaline pH) — catabolic от gastroparesis с Cold energy

drug_induced_dissociation.principle: Препараты со strong energetic signature могут dissociate systemic membrane axis от local energy state.
dissociators: GLP-1 agonists — pull M-A1/A2 → M-0 normally, но в Yin patterns могут precipitate M-D drift
Corticosteroids — push M-A1 in tissue locally + Yang-Heat systemically; but suppression of natural M-A → eventual M-D
Beta-blockers — Yang reduction systemically + Cold local pattern; membrane effects complex
drug_induced_dissociation.clinical_implication: When patient on these drugs, assess BOTH axes independently (energy state via pH/symptoms/thermal preference; membrane state via SG/K/pain timing/WBC). Don't assume correlation.

yin_dominant: Epicrisis: muted, may not have clear crisis point
frail_elderly_T5: Direct jumps to PCL-B fibrosis without clear CA

membrane_modulates_phase: M-D states accelerate phase progression (faster CA→PCL → exhaustion)

lesion_systemic_paradox.observation: pH опухолевой ткани часто противоположен системному pH. Опухоль имеет inverse local membrane vs systemic state.
lesion_systemic_paradox.example: Systemic M-A2 (anabolic, alkaline urine) + lesion locally acidic (catabolic at tumor site) → treatment direction conflict; cannot be done with single agent.
implications: ALWAYS measure both systemic and lesion pH where possible
Treatment direction must flip based on measurement point
Single-direction therapy can worsen one compartment while helping other
Standard «alkalinize for cancer» advice can be harmful in some cases
lesion_systemic_paradox.approach: Systemic: based on systemic pH/membrane. Local: based on lesion pH/local membrane. Often requires multi-agent approach addressing both compartments differently.

adt_catastrophe.observation: Любой пациент с раком простаты, начинающий ADT, ГАРАНТИРОВАННО переходит из системного M-A в M-D2/D3 за 6-12 месяцев. Это факт METACOD-канона.
adt_catastrophe.mechanism: Testosterone суппрессия = removal of major anabolic driver + cancer cachexia tendency → inevitable sarcopenia + multi-system M-D drift.
mandatory_support_stack_day_one: Лейцин 3 г на каждый приём пищи

pregnancy_m_a_shift.observation: Беременность = физиологический M-A shift, не патология.

Aldosterone↑, plasma volume +50%, K-shift, mild edema normal

ACE/ARB — absolute CI T2/T3 — renal fetal damage = destruction of M-A renal program
NSAID T3 — premature ductus arteriosus closure

trajectory: Normal: return to M-0 within months
Pathological: stuck in PCL-A (chronic inflammation) or PCL-B (excessive fibrosis)

treatment_direction_steps: Step 3: Identify current phase of active processes
Step 5: Build treatment addressing all axes

three_layer_architecture.layer_1: Base alkalinization (universal) — maintain blood pH 7.4, ratio 4:1 alkali:acid; diet/lifestyle/minerals; static (always applied)
three_layer_architecture.layer_2: Membrane-specific therapy — correct membrane state toward M-0; Revici principles + modern pharma with energy mapping; dynamic (revise every 30 days)
three_layer_architecture.layer_3: Phase-appropriate intervention — timing-correct based on current phase; phase-matching pharma + non-pharmacologic; variable timing

drug_selection_algorithm: Membrane direction match (M-A→M-0 vs M-D→M-0 vs M-0 maintenance)
Phase appropriateness (CA needs different drugs than PCL-A)
Special pattern flags (pregnancy, ADT, oncology lesion-systemic)
three_axis_integration.drug_selection_note: Conceptual в v1.0. Operationalization requires validated constitutional/membrane/phase assessment + drug database with all three axis profiles.

core_open_problems: Constitution determination algorithm — currently clinical gestalt (Mark); not transferable; no validated questionnaire/biomarker panel
Membrane assessment standardization — pH 4-point + bridge axis established, но needs standard collection protocols, reference ranges by age/gender, cross-validation
M-A2/A3/D2/D3 full development — v1.0 fixes basic signatures from v0.5 stubs; full 10-section deployment pending; especially M-S detailed signatures
Phase determination from clinical data — signatures described, but assigning phase to complex multi-system patient is interpretive; need decision tree/scoring
Quality dimension biomarker validation — panels are hypotheses; optimal ranges = standard refs + Mark canonical adjustments; need case-based validation
validation_path: Step 1: Retrospective case documentation (50-100 Mark cases with three-axis assessment + outcomes)
Step 2: Pattern emergence (which axis combinations predict which responses)
Step 3: Inter-rater reliability (train second clinician, blinded cases)
Step 4: Prospective recording (pre-treatment assessment, predicted response, actual outcome)
Step 5: Formal validation studies (IRB, pre-specified protocol)
known_limitations: Subjective elements — clinical gestalt component significant
No formal RCT support для constitutional matching predictions
Theoretical extrapolations for membrane levels not yet fully validated
Biorhythmic dimension acknowledged but not incorporated
Multi-system phase parallelism handling not yet operationalized
path_to_v2: Treatment matrix integration (drug × constitution × membrane × phase)

quick_reference.axis_3_phase: CA → PCL-A → Epicrisis → PCL-B → Normotonia; Yang/Yin alternation; KO-cycle progression; multi-system parallelism; fast
special_patterns: Pregnancy physiological M-A shift by trimester
validation_status: Membrane direction: bridge axis biomarkers established
Phase assessment: signatures described, scoring open
Full RCT validation: not yet done
